verdict: Drafts reviewed; one source-registration correction required and editorial improvements recommended. This is not publication approval.
method: Read every article body, including interpretation, next-check decisions and explicit applicability limitations. All100 are listed with exact reviewed-byte SHA256.

Independently compared20 varied articles, including all10 needs-review items, against their captured original MediaWiki sourceText at the exact cited revision. Recomputed source-text hashes and inspected the original OEM PDF page images for P1545/P1624.

Checked the Fuel Trim Info supplemental original revision for P1111. Read all four conflicting pedal-sensor sources together. Compared P1571 assignment dictionary title with the original wiki wording.

Automated revision/hash/registration checks across all100 are structural checks, not a claim of deep factual review of all100 sources. Opening-paragraph decimal/component identifiers all occur in their own source text.

Excluded frontmatter, headings and Sources and applicability footers from prose similarity. Compared exact substantive paragraphs of15+words, exact sentences of12+words, and numeric/code-normalized seven-word shingles across4950 pairs. Manual reading assesses semantic repetition that lexical scores miss.

findings.finding: Article cites nhtsa-vw-p1624-09g, absent from the reviewed shared diagnostic source index. The article facts are supported by the retained original PDF; this is a registry integration defect.
findings.correction: Root should add the source record from wave3/writer24/oem-p1624.json to the shared index, preserving its URL, PDF SHA256, 2-page count, US2015–2017 Jetta/Passat/Golf09G scope and Tech Tip status; rerun source-reference validation.

findings.location: frontmatter.sourcePages for nhtsa-vw-p1545-throttle-wiring and source footer
findings.finding: The VW revision2018652/6 is correct but the revision table is on physical page8; the current locator lists only pages1 and5.
findings.correction: Add physical page8 to the VW sourcePages list and source-footer page list. Pages1/5 already support application and conditional replacement; page8 directly proves the /6 revision.

findings.finding: No copied substantive paragraphs or12+word sentences were found, but manual reading found substantial semantic repetition within injector, ignition, pressure-valve and ABS-referral families. Repeated content explains circuit versus component, missing pinout/specification, and clearing a fault not proving repair. Separate circuit identities and fault directions are real useful distinctions; wording variation alone should not be counted as new diagnostic depth.

examples.sharedSubstance: Cylinder/N-code changes; both cover fuse/harness/injector/ECM alternatives, manual-specific resistance testing and post-repair circuit/running checks.
N215/N91 versus N217/N93 identification; both cover open/ground conditions, unspecified measurements and the01V16-pin corrosion lead.
Both refer to J104/address03 memory, explain cross-module dependencies and require addressing the originating ABS fault.

findings.correction: Before treating these as fully developed SEO guides, shorten repeated generic caution passages and seek applicable original repair information for genuinely branch-specific evidence. Retain separate code pages and honest shared-procedure attribution; do not invent tests or forced differences merely to lower similarity.

findings.finding: All10 existing needs-review flags are supported by actual source limitations, and the body text preserves them. The review does not resolve original conjecture, anecdote, identifier errors or incompatible generalized pedal curves.
findings.correction: Retain these flags unless new application-specific evidence resolves the underlying issue. Do not promote this independent review to human-mechanic approval.

limitations: 80 articles received body review plus structural source-locator checks, not independent deep factual verification. No claim is made that their every technical fact has been re-established.
Ross-Tech is an independent diagnostic-tool publisher. Its original wiki text is primary evidence of what Ross-Tech states, not OEM proof or verified fitment for every Volkswagen.
Historical OEM documents establish the cited narrow cases, not current supersession status, worldwide applicability, warranty eligibility, or repair authorization.
No vehicle testing, mechanic signoff, search-demand validation, publication or indexing occurred.
Source text and PDF captures remain scratch research evidence; this report does not reproduce the manuals.
mutations: Only this report and reviewer scratch helpers were written; no batch24 article, assignment or shared source index was edited.
